members.name: Naveen Kumar
members.bio: Naveen Kumar is the Chief AI Officer at Nainovate, where he leads the vision, AI strategy and product development of GenX — the Intelligence Engine behind Nainovate's approach to AI transformation.

detail.background: With more than two decades of experience across enterprise technology, data and AI, Naveen has built and led technology and product initiatives across manufacturing, real estate, banking and retail. His experience spans enterprise platforms, data and AI systems, intelligent automation, product strategy, and taking technology from architecture and concept through deployment and adoption. At Nainovate, he brings together AI, technology, product and business strategy to help organizations move from AI experimentation to organizational capability — redesigning how they think, decide and operate, and embedding intelligence into real-world workflows and outcomes.

members.name: Sandeep Kalmane
members.role: Chief Business Advisor — Built Environment & Infrastructure
members.bio: Sandeep Kalmane is a construction and project-management professional with more than two decades of experience across the Middle East, spanning project management, commercial management and end-to-end project delivery. His experience covers the full project lifecycle — from proposals and pre-construction through procurement, execution, project controls and handover.

detail.background: He leads a project management and advisory practice working across the built environment, infrastructure and sustainability-led sectors, including renewable energy. As Chief Business Advisor at Nainovate, Sandeep brings deep industry expertise, commercial perspective and market relationships to help shape GenX applications for the Built Environment and Infrastructure sectors and accelerate strategic business development across India and the Middle East.

principles.title: Focused execution
principles.body: Engineering, AI and product operate as one team — decisions stay close to the work, not buried in hand-offs.

principles.title: Production first
principles.body: We design for deployment, observability, security and operational ownership — not just demos.

principles.title: Enterprise by default
principles.body: Governance, security and auditability are part of the architecture from the start, not added later.

cta.body: Bring us a decision that is slow, manual or unauditable today. We will show you what GenX does with it in production.
cta.hiringNote: Hiring selectively. If decision intelligence is the problem you want to work on, start a conversation.
